column1: # Expected output lines of the oracle syscall suite (user/init modes mm ids time signal fs proc fork jobctl pipe xstate tty ttyin ttykbd names busybox procfs dynelf threads futex) on the pinned
# Linux 6.18.57 reference kernel: QEMU q35, -cpu qemu64 (TCG), -smp 1 -m 512M, "console=ttyS0 panic=-1 vdso=0 norandmaps -- <mode>",

# the harness-built /init and generated initramfs (target/linux-reference/init-reference-006 for mm ids time signal fs proc, -009/-010 for fork, -011 for jobctl and pipe, -014 for tty, ttyin and ttykbd (ttyin/ttykbd are driven through the serial port / QMP send-key by `xtask tty-oracle`; ttykbd runs with "console=ttyS0 console=tty0" so that /dev/console is the vt; kinds stage and echo are the driver's transcript rows, see docs/kernel-tooling.md); docs/implementation.md#oracle-syscall-test-suite).

# The `xstate` group is the exception to the machine: it drives AVX-512 and PKRU state, so it was recorded under KVM with -cpu host (AMD Zen 5) and runs only where KVM does (target/linux-reference/init-reference-012; docs/implementation.md#extended-cpu-state-xsave-pkru). Its `info` rows name the machine (XCR0, sizes, offsets) and are not compared by value.

# The `names` group (mkdir, rmdir, rename, link, symlink, chmod, chown, utimensat, truncate, fsync, statfs, writev, sendfile, getrandom's argument errors, reboot's checks, mknodat, `#!` scripts, vfork including an expiring ITIMER_REAL a nested vfork killed by its child and a three-deep chain with both middle tasks killed) is CPU independent: recorded under TCG `-cpu qemu64` like the first groups (target/linux-reference/init-reference-016, re-recorded with the fix-round-1 /init in init-reference-017; the `vfork-chain-*` rows and the `names` summary from init-reference-019, fix round 2). The `busybox` group runs the host's BusyBox v1.36.1 (sha256 1097cdef...f0d, static, x86-64-v4) through `user/init` mode `bbrun` and was recorded under KVM `-cpu host` with `initramfs.cpio` followed by the generated `busybox.cpio` as the initrd (init-reference-016, re-recorded with the fix-round-1 /init in init-reference-017: the `getrandom` clamp rows): each row is a command's exit status or signal and its escaped output, and the case is `unavailable` without that exact program, KVM or AVX-512 (docs/implementation.md#busybox-lane).

# The `procfs` group (mount(2), umount2(2), /proc) was recorded on the same machine as the first groups (target/linux-reference/init-reference-018, fix round 1 target/linux-reference/init-reference-020, fix round 2 target/linux-reference/init-reference-021, fix round 3 target/linux-reference/init-reference-022; docs/implementation.md#procfs-and-mounts); its last check remounts the root read-only and back, so it runs in a boot of its own.

# The `dynelf` group (dynamically linked host programs through ET_DYN images and PT_INTERP interpreters, synthetic ELF layout and error probes, mremap(2), CLONE_CHILD_SETTID and the `sys-*` system call probes of user/init `tests/dynsys.rs`; user/init mode `dynrun`) was recorded under KVM `-cpu host` with `nofsgsbase` (AT_HWCAP2 0) from `initramfs.cpio` followed by the generated `dynamic.cpio` (target/linux-reference/init-reference-025, fix round 1; init-reference-024 was the first recording; docs/implementation.md#dynamic-elf-lane). The values of AT_HWCAP and AT_MINSIGSTKSZ (CPUID of the recording machine) are masked to `*` in the auxv rows. The host binaries and libraries are pinned by sha256 in xtask/src/fixture.rs; the case is `unavailable` without them, KVM or AVX-512.

# The `threads` group (clone/clone3 with CLONE_THREAD and the sharing flags, tids, thread- and process-directed signals, exit against exit_group, the zombie leader, execve from a thread, group stop with threads, per-thread FPU state) and the `futex` group (futex(2), futex2, robust lists) are libc-free programs that make threads with a raw clone and join them through CLONE_CHILD_CLEARTID; CPU independent, recorded under TCG `-cpu qemu64` on the same machine as the first groups (target/linux-reference/init-reference-026; docs/implementation.md#threads-and-futexes).
# Columns: group, kind (check|info|summary|stage|echo), name, line (the exact stdout line without the newline).
# A consumer matches "check" and "summary" rows exactly; "info" rows are recorded observations (tmpfs d_off cookies), not requirements.
